description: This file contains unit tests for Prometheus metrics related to a proxy handling chat completions, including testing metrics for failure cases, success cases, fallback mechanisms, team and user budget tracking, and user email tracking in a software project that integrates with OpenAI APIs.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A client class for interacting asynchronously with the OpenAI API, used here to simulate chat completion requests within tests.

methods.name: make_bad_chat_completion_request(session, key)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a simulated bad chat completion request to test failure metrics.

methods.name: make_good_chat_completion_request(session, key)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a simulated successful chat completion request to test success metrics.

methods.name: make_chat_completion_request_with_fallback(session, key)
methods.description: Simulates a chat completion request with fallback models, testing fallback metrics.

methods.name: verify_latency_metrics(metrics: str)
methods.description: Verifies that latency metrics utilize the correct bucket distribution, checking the presence of expected latency buckets.

methods.name: str create_test_team( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a new team for testing team budget metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_test_user( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, user_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a new test user with specified data.

methods.name: str get_prometheus_metrics(session: aiohttp.ClientSession)
methods.description: Fetches current Prometheus metrics from the server for validation.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] extract_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, team_id: str)
methods.description: Extracts team budget metrics from the Prometheus output for a given team ID.

methods.name: str create_test_key(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str)
methods.description: Generates a new testing API key for a team.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_team_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific team.

methods.name: test_team_budget_metrics()
methods.description: End-to-end test verifying budget tracking for a team associated with chat requests.

methods.name: str create_test_key_with_budget( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, budget_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates an API key with budget constraints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_key_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific API key.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] extract_key_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, key_id: str)
methods.description: Extracts API key budget metrics from the Prometheus output.

methods.name: test_key_budget_metrics()
methods.description: Tests the metrics tracking for API keys with budget constraints.

methods.name: test_user_email_metrics()
methods.description: Verifies that user emails are correctly tracked in metrics.

methods.name: test_user_email_in_all_required_metrics()
methods.description: Verifies that the user email label is present in all relevant metrics.

methods.name: test_proxy_failure_metrics()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: test_proxy_fallback_metrics()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: test_proxy_success_metrics()
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: create_test_key
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_test_key(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: extract_budget_metrics
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, team_id: str) -> Dict[str, float]:$/

ctags.name: extract_key_budget_metrics
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_key_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, key_id: str) -> Dict[str, float]:$/

ctags.name: get_key_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_key_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, key: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: get_team_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_team_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
